limitations: This one-page PostgreSQL connector support supplement enriches one of245discovered connector rows, using existing capabilities and canonical owners. It does not close the connector catalog, add Console implementation, or qualify any runtime.

The page was captured September20 America/New_York after the targetSeptember19 freeze; exact timestamp and bytes are retained. Last-Modified does not prove historical equivalence. Existing earlier catalog discovery establishes the named connector, not these exact support modes. Historical-validity HOLD remains.

Vendor general JDBC42/PostgreSQL8.2+ compatibility is not a version-by-capability matrix. Do not project8.2support onto logical CDC Iceberg streaming/table exports or every authentication mode; exact driver/server versions and runtime combinations require independent compatibility evidence.

GA/beta labels describe vendor lifecycle only. Required capabilities remain release requirements independent of those labels; Console acceptance stays unestablished with null executable bindings. A documented mode is not an implementation or valid connector fixture.

CDC table identifiers replication identities initial snapshot/WAL ordering updates deletes truncates checkpoints retention schema changes slot/publication cleanup failover duplicate delivery and backpressure are not specified by this page and remain required source-specific contracts and failure oracles.

One slot/publication per source and multiple tables are logical configuration claims, not unlimited safe capacity. Bound slots tables connections retained WAL memory throughput and cancellation, including destination failure and resource starvation.

Credential scopes and external effects require isolated canonical connection/export ownership, current resource/source disclosure and least privilege. External code must never receive Console auth/payroll database credentials; a code example is not permission to mutate business truth or execute payments.

External psycopg2 write example is not an idempotency unknown-commit or exactly-once contract. Query parameters and identifier mappings need strict validation, remote transactions require durable delivery receipts, and output publication must not imply a remote effect is reconciled.

The connector UI verify-full default is separate from the sample external Python connection, which does not show sslmode or trust configuration. Require explicit tested TLS/hostname/CA/expiry/rotation/downgrade behavior for every execution path; do not infer secure defaults from sample omission.

Vendor RDS guidance names rds-ca-2019-root.pem. Preserve this historical reference but do not install or treat it as the current valid trust anchor; active region/instance CA and certificate validity must be independently checked and rotation tested.

Iceberg sync inclusion does not settle the Console dataset-format decision. Retain PostgreSQL as authoritative business substrate and complete the planned bounded correctness/workload comparison before introducing a dataset format.

No federation pushdown license agent-hosting server extensions authentication plugins schema drift type mapping connection quotas or exact retry semantics are established unless explicitly recorded. Missing dimensions stay visible and cannot inherit support from another connector.
